content.short: Arkham is a deanonymizing blockchain intelligence platform that provides transparency to the crypto market.
content.description: Arkham is a groundbreaking blockchain intelligence platform that uses artificial intelligence to provide deep transparency and deanonymization for the crypto market. Its core feature, the Arkham Intel Exchange, allows users to buy and sell information about the owners of blockchain addresses, creating a marketplace for high-quality on-chain research. The platform's 'Ultra' AI engine links blockchain addresses to real-world entities, providing users with a comprehensive view of the activities of funds, exchanges, and high-net-worth individuals. By enabling users to track movements of funds and analyze historical data with professional-grade tools, Arkham aims to eliminate the obscurity of the blockchain and foster a more accountable and secure Web3 ecosystem.
content.meta: Arkham is the leading blockchain intelligence platform, providing AI-powered deanonymization and data analytics for the global cryptocurrency market.
